verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official MCP server that brings persistent memory to MCP-compatible assistants, explicitly naming Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue and Codex. Because those tools all point at one Cognee instance, they can draw on a common memory store, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of ChatGPT support, explicit documentation that several assistants share one memory/user graph at the same time, and independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-tool memory sharing.
